folderName.text: A folder name is 1-31 letters, digits, - or _. Anything else is skipped.

foldersExaminedNote: Only the first 32 folders under /themes (by name) are examined at all; of those, at most 8 packs load.

reboot.text: A new or changed pack needs a reboot to appear. The device reads the SD card at boot only.

packs.text: At most 8 packs load, chosen as the first 8 by folder name, and only the first 32 folders (by name) are examined at all. Folder names are letters, digits, - and _ only. A theme name must be unique and cannot be UMBRAVOX, BAPH0MAU5, CVLT OF BAPH0MAU5 or COSMIC MUFFIN; otherwise that pack is skipped.

centrepiece.text: The centrepiece picture is at most 96x96 pixels and 16 colours. Photos are reduced and will look posterised; expect pixel art, not photographs.

header.text: Header text is uppercase only (lowercase is shown as capitals), limited to letters, digits, space and common punctuation, and 18 characters at most.

characters.text: The name, header and author cannot contain a double quote or a backslash. The device does not read escapes, so a pack with either would be skipped.

rgb565.text: Colours are stored as RGB565, so fine differences between near colours disappear. The designer previews the colours the panel will really show.

presets.text: Layout comes from presets only: two dial sizes. There is no custom screen layout, font or animation yet.

builtins.text: Sweeps and alerts come from the built-in set. Gaze and the Summon rite are not available to packs; they belong to the Baphomet seal.

alerts.text: A theme cannot hide or disable alerts. Status and alert-edge colours that are too close to the background are replaced with safe defaults.

byname.text: The selected theme is saved by name. Renaming a pack makes the device fall back to UMBRAVOX until you select it again.

browser.text: Installing straight from the page needs desktop Chrome, Edge or Opera. Other browsers use the zip download; copy the folder to the card by hand.

fat32.text: The SD card must be FAT32, the same as for logging.

skipped.text: A pack that fails to load is skipped, never partly applied. The ASPECT screen shows the skipped count as N SKIPPED and DIAG LOG split around the preview, and the reason is in /diag.log.

trust.text: Packs are checked for format, not for taste or origin: nothing here signs, vets or moderates a pack. Only install packs from people you trust.
